instruction: In Thunderbird, create two new folders named 'Personal' and 'Work' under Local Folders.

args.query: title = 'attachment' and 'root' in parents and trashed = false

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two new folders (Personal and Work) in Thunderbird Local Folders. Evaluator checks both folders exist.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks for both required folders (Personal and Work) with complete coverage
Getter logic uses appropriate method (env.controller.get_file) to check folder existence in Thunderbird profile
Metric properly implements partial credit scoring (50% per folder), allowing verification of incomplete task completion
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts boolean existence flags, metric compares booleans against expected boolean values
Configuration properly parameterizes profile path and folder names for flexibility
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Verify that Thunderbird actually stores Local Folders at path '{profile_path}/Mail/Local Folders/{folder_name}' - Thunderbird may use .sbd subdirectories or .msf files with different naming conventions depending on version
Consider checking for folder existence using multiple possible formats (.sbd directory, .msf file, or plain directory) to ensure compatibility across Thunderbird versions
Add edge case handling for when get_file returns empty bytes vs None to distinguish between empty files and non-existent paths
